title: Unbounded knapsack — coins you can reuse
summary: Items can be used any number of times; loop capacity upwards. Coin change (minimum coins) and coin change II (number of combinations).

sections.title: Idea
sections.body: ✍️ Each coin can be used again, so taking a coin leads to the **same** row: `dp[c] = best(dp[c], dp[c − coin] + 1)` where `dp[c − coin]` may already include this coin. Loop capacity **upwards**.

sections.title: Minimum coins
Number of combinations
Variations
sections.body:
- Perfect squares (LeetCode 279): coins = 1, 4, 9, …, minimum count.
- Combination sum IV (LeetCode 377): **ordered** sequences → amount outer, nums inner.
- Rod cutting, minimum cost tickets (with a twist).

sections.title: Complexity
sections.body: O(amount × number of coins) time, O(amount) space.
